import PV_L2C_InverseField
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_InterpolationNodes
open scoped BigOperators
open PV_L2C_M31
local instance : Fact (Nat.Prime 2147483647) := ⟨R0Z.m31_prime⟩

def node (i : Nat) : ZMod p := i

theorem distinct (i j : Nat) (hi : i < 28) (hj : j < 28) (he : i ≠ j) : node i ≠ node j := by
  intro h
  have hv := congrArg ZMod.val h
  simp only [node,ZMod.val_natCast,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by change i < 2147483647;omega : i < p),
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by change j < 2147483647;omega : j < p)] at hv
  exact he hv
#print axioms distinct

def denominator (i n : Nat) : ZMod p :=
  ∏ j ∈ Finset.range n, if j=i then 1 else node i-node j

theorem nonzero (i n : Nat) (hi : i < 28) (hn : n ≤ 28) : denominator i n ≠ 0 := by
  unfold denominator
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro j hj
  have hj' : j < 28 := lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hj) hn
  split_ifs with he
  · exact one_ne_zero
  · exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (distinct i j hi hj' (Ne.symm he))
#print axioms nonzero
end PV_L2C_InterpolationNodes

import PV_L2C_BaseGuard
import PV_L2C_SecureGuard
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_N3Guard
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
inductive Failure where
  | publicError

def baseAll (base : Fin 26 → List U32) : List (Fin 26) → Except Failure Unit
  | [] => .ok ()
  | c::cs => match PV_L2C_BaseGuard.check (base c) with
    | .error _ => .error .publicError
    | .ok () => baseAll base cs

def secure (column : Nat → PV_L2C_NativeQ.Q) : Result (Except Failure Unit) := do
  let r ← PV_L2C_SecureGuard.loop 1024 0 column
  match r with
  | .error _ => ok (.error .publicError)
  | .ok () => ok (.ok ())

/-- The exact three-call guard cut: base columns, then d, then g. All error
arms are retained. Header, material and observation associations are separate. -/
def run (base : Fin 26 → List U32) (d g : Nat → PV_L2C_NativeQ.Q) :
    Result (Except Failure Unit) :=
  match baseAll base (List.finRange 26) with
  | .error e => ok (.error e)
  | .ok () => do
    let dr ← secure d
    match dr with
    | .error e => ok (.error e)
    | .ok () => secure g

theorem base_expected (base : Fin 26 → List U32)
    (h : ∀ c, PV_L2C_BaseGuard.check (base c) = .ok ()) (cs : List (Fin 26)) :
    baseAll base cs = .ok () := by
  induction cs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih => rw [baseAll,h c];exact ih
#print axioms base_expected

theorem expected (base : Fin 26 → List U32) (d g : Nat → PV_L2C_NativeQ.Q)
    (hb : ∀ c, PV_L2C_BaseGuard.check (base c) = .ok ())
    (hd : PV_L2C_SecureGuard.loop 1024 0 d = ok (.ok ()))
    (hg : PV_L2C_SecureGuard.loop 1024 0 g = ok (.ok ())) : run base d g = ok (.ok ()) := by
  rw [run,base_expected base hb]
  simp only [secure,hd,hg,bind_tc_ok]
#print axioms expected
end PV_L2C_N3Guard

import PV_L2C_SamplerFill
import PV_L2C_RouteBaseGuard
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_SampledMaskOnly
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result PV_L2C_M31 PV_L2C_StateSampler

def table (values : List word) : Fin 1024 → word := fun r => values[r.val]!

theorem sampled {S : Type} (next : S → Result (word × S)) (fuel : Nat)
    (s s1 : S) (values : List word)
    (h : PV_L2C_SamplerFill.fill (scalar next fuel) 1024 s = ok (.ok values,s1)) :
    ∀ r, canonical (table values r) := by
  obtain ⟨hl,hc⟩ := PV_L2C_SamplerFill.scalar next 1024 fuel s s1 values h
  intro r
  have hr : r.val < values.length := by rw [hl];exact r.isLt
  apply hc
  rw [table,getElem!_pos values r.val hr]
  exact List.getElem_mem hr
#print axioms sampled

def balanced (values : List word) (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (dependent : Usize) :=
  PV_L2C_ScalarBalance.output (table values) active dependent

theorem guard {S : Type} (next : S → Result (word × S)) (fuel : Nat)
    (s s1 : S) (values : List word)
    (h : PV_L2C_SamplerFill.fill (scalar next fuel) 1024 s = ok (.ok values,s1))
    (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (dependent : Usize) :
    PV_L2C_BaseGuard.check (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 1024 => (⟨balanced values active dependent r⟩ : U32))) = .ok () := by
  apply PV_L2C_BaseGuard.expected
  · simp only [List.length_ofFn]
  · intro j hj
    rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,List.getElem?_ofFn,dif_pos hj]
    exact PV_L2C_ScalarCanonical.output_canonical _ active
      (sampled next fuel s s1 values h) dependent ⟨j,hj⟩
#print axioms guard
end PV_L2C_SampledMaskOnly
